realTalk.title: Sound Familiar?
realTalk.description: None of this is her fault. She's doing what she knows. But your child is learning from every one of these moments. This programme gives her something better - so your child gets something better.

items.title: He cries, she hands him the iPad. He's learning that screens fix feelings.
He's three and hasn't held his own spoon. He's not lazy - he was never given the chance.
"If you don't eat, the monster will come." He's not learning to eat. He's learning to fear.
Every shoe tied for them is a moment of independence they didn't get to practise.
Two sets of rules, one confused child. Consistency is how children feel safe.
He falls. Before he can even try to get up, she's already there. He's learning he can't.

questions.question: What will my child gain from the My Best Auntie course?
questions.answer: Your child's caregiver will learn practical Montessori techniques for daily routines, gentle discipline without threats or bribes, age-appropriate activities for children aged 0-6, and how to foster independence in a small Hong Kong home. The result: your child builds confidence, emotional regulation, and real skills through everyday moments. The course includes group sessions, home visits, and personalised coaching.

questions.question: Is the My Best Auntie course suitable for helpers with no childcare experience?
questions.answer: Yes. The My Best Auntie domestic helper childcare training is designed for all experience levels. No Montessori knowledge or prior childcare training is required - just a willingness to learn.

questions.question: How is My Best Auntie different from a standard helper training course?
questions.answer: Unlike generic helper training, My Best Auntie is a Montessori-based programme with home visits, personalised coaching, and ongoing support. We observe your helper with your child in your home and provide specific, actionable guidance - not just classroom theory.

questions.question: How long is the My Best Auntie helper training course?
questions.answer: The course runs over 9 weeks with three group training sessions, three home visits, and three parent alignment calls. It is designed to create lasting behavioural change, not a one-off lecture.

questions.question: Can I join the My Best Auntie course if my helper speaks limited English?
questions.answer: Yes. Our Montessori helper training uses clear language, demonstrations, visual guidance, and repetition. Fluent English is not required - understanding and consistency are what matter.

questions.question: Do I need to have a helper to book a consultation?
questions.answer: Only for the Auntie-Child focus. Home Assessment and Parent-Child work whether you have help or not. If you have a helper, I'll still loop her in where it's useful - consistency between the adults in the house is half the work.

questions.question: I'm not sure which focus I need. How do I choose?
questions.answer: That's what the free 20-minute call is for. Tell me what's feeling hard - mornings, mealtimes, the playroom chaos, your helper and you pulling in different directions - and I'll tell you which focus will give you the most traction.

questions.question: How is this different from the 9-week course?
questions.answer: The course is a full training for your helper - nine weeks of structured learning, practice, and follow-through. Consultations are single-focus and short. They're the right fit if you want a clear answer to one specific question - or if you want to test how we work together before committing to the course.

questions.question: Can I upgrade from Essentials to Deep Dive later?
questions.answer: Yes. If you start with Essentials and realise you want me there for the implementation, you can upgrade within 30 days and only pay the difference.

questions.question: In-person or online?
questions.answer: In-person for the assessment visits - I need to see your space, your child, and your helper in their actual environment. The follow-up call and WhatsApp support are remote.

questions.question: What ages do you work with?
questions.answer: From baby (0) to 6 years. If your child is older, message me and I'll tell you honestly whether I'm the right fit.

questions.question: What if my helper's English isn't strong?
questions.answer: Not a problem. I keep language simple, demonstrate rather than lecture, and leave her with visual or written scripts she can refer back to. Many of the helpers I work with are more comfortable in Tagalog or Bahasa - I adapt.

questions.question: Do I need to prepare anything before the visit?
questions.answer: No. Come as you are. A "cleaned-up" house or a rehearsed routine gives me less to work with, not more. I want to see real life.

questions.question: What's in the written report?
questions.answer: A prioritised list of what to change and why, photos or sketches where useful, and specific scripts or routines tailored to your family. Not a generic handout - something you and your helper can actually use.

questions.question: How soon can we start?
questions.answer: Usually within 1-2 weeks of booking. If you're in a tight spot, tell me on the intro call and I'll see what I can do.

questions.question: What if I book and then need to reschedule?
questions.answer: Life with small children - I get it. Reschedule anytime up to 24 hours before, no charge.

questions.question: Can I book more than one focus?
questions.answer: Yes, and many families do - often Home Assessment first, then Auntie-Child once the space is set up. I'll suggest an order on the intro call if you want to do more than one.

questions.question: We live in a small apartment. Will this still work?
questions.answer: Yes. Most Hong Kong families do, and so do I. We specialise in small-space Montessori setups, shared rooms, and practical routines that do not require expensive materials or furniture.

questions.question: Do I need to follow Montessori perfectly to work with you?
questions.answer: No. This is Montessori-informed, not Montessori-dogmatic. We focus on principles that improve daily life: independence, respect, consistency, and emotional regulation - adapted to modern Hong Kong homes and caregiving realities.

questions.question: Who is Evolve Sprouts for?
questions.answer: Evolve Sprouts is for families in Hong Kong with children aged 0-6 who want to make sure their child's daily care supports real development - especially when a helper is the primary caregiver during working hours.

questions.question: How is Montessori relevant for infants and toddlers at home?
questions.answer: Montessori is not just for classrooms. We teach caregivers to create child-friendly home environments and practical routines that build independence from infancy.

questions.question: What is the difference between positive discipline and regular discipline?
questions.answer: Traditional discipline often relies on rewards and punishments. Positive discipline focuses on understanding behaviour, setting clear boundaries, and coaching children toward self-regulation.

questions.question: Are these strategies culturally appropriate for Hong Kong families?
questions.answer: Yes. We adapt Montessori principles to local lifestyles, including small homes, busy schedules, and helper-supported caregiving.

questions.question: Will this make my child too soft or less competitive?
questions.answer: Children raised with independence, emotional regulation, and responsibility often become more confident, focused, and resilient - not less capable.

questions.question: My child has tantrums, hits, or refuses to listen. Can Montessori help?
questions.answer: Yes, but not with quick fixes. We review environment, adult responses, routines, and developmental expectations, then give practical steps you can apply consistently.

questions.question: Does Montessori mean no discipline or letting children do anything?
questions.answer: No. Montessori discipline means clear limits, consistent routines, and calm leadership. Children thrive when freedom is paired with structure.

questions.question: Will I get practical tools or just theory?
questions.answer: You will get practical tools, including routines, behaviour scripts, environment checklists, and reflection sheets. We always turn principles into action.

questions.question: What if parents and helpers disagree on discipline?
questions.answer: This is very common. We align adults first so children receive consistent messages, expectations, and routines.

questions.question: My helper does not speak English fluently. Is that a problem?
questions.answer: No. Our method uses clear language, repetition, demonstrations, and visual guidance. The goal is understanding and consistency.

questions.question: Do you work directly with helpers?
questions.answer: Yes. We provide helper-friendly coaching, practical scripts, and routines aligned with family values.

questions.question: What services do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer a 9-week helper training programme, family consultations, home setup guidance, and parent support - all designed to improve how your child is cared for every day.

questions.question: Do you offer packages or bundles?
questions.answer: Yes. Some families choose bundled support for deeper change. We recommend options after understanding your family needs.

questions.question: Why is this priced higher than a one-off parenting talk?
questions.answer: Because this is personalised and implementation-focused. You are paying for real-life observation, tailored guidance, and ongoing support - not just motivation.

questions.question: Is this just a one-time session or ongoing support?
questions.answer: Both options are available. Some families need a reset plan, while others benefit from longer support as children grow.

questions.question: Do you guarantee results?
questions.answer: Children are not machines, so no ethical professional guarantees instant perfection. What we do guarantee is clear guidance, practical strategy, and honest support.

questions.question: Is this backed by evidence?
questions.answer: Our work is informed by Montessori principles, child development research, and years of practical application with Hong Kong families and helpers.

questions.question: What makes Evolve Sprouts different from other parenting coaches?
questions.answer: We focus on the person who's actually with your child every day. By combining Montessori-informed guidance with a deep understanding of Hong Kong family-helper dynamics, we create real change where it matters most - in the daily moments that shape your child's development.

questions.question: Is this suitable for international families in Hong Kong?
questions.answer: Yes. We regularly support multicultural families navigating different expectations around discipline, education, and caregiving.

questions.question: What if I am not sure which service I need?
questions.answer: That is normal. Reach out and we will help you choose the best starting point with no pressure.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: Start with a consultation or contact us directly. We will guide you to the most suitable service for your family.

questions.question: Have not found what you need?
questions.answer: Get in touch - we are happy to help. Contact us through the Contact Us page.

items.title: Private 1:1 Coaching (Family-Specific)
items.description: Three tailored sessions inside your real routines. We observe, align expectations, adjust responses, and coach precise language. Group learning builds knowledge. Private coaching makes it work in your home.

items.title: Parent Strategy Calls
items.description: We step back, assess progress, and realign direction. You will know what is working, what needs adjusting, and how to prevent small issues becoming long-term patterns.

items.title: Auntie WhatsApp Community

items.title: Scripts, Tools & Real-Life Examples

items.title: WhatsApp Support for Parents
items.description: Direct access for questions between sessions. Early guidance prevents escalation and keeps everyone aligned.

items.title: Written Reports After Each Private Session

hero.title: Hello, fellow parents!
hero.subtitle: I'm Ida, and I understand the weight of choosing someone to care for your child.
hero.description: As a Montessori-trained educator and mother of two in Hong Kong, I've been where you are - searching for guidance you can trust. Evolve Sprouts was born from that very search.
hero.imageAlt: Ida De Gregorio from Evolve Sprouts

intro.title: Hello! I'm Ida - AMI Montessori certified for 0-3 and 3-6, MEd from the University of Hong Kong, Stanford Child Nutrition.
intro.description: I left a teaching career because I saw how much children's growth depends on what happens at home - and how little support the people raising them actually get. This work is personal to me - because I'm navigating the same journey you are.
intro.imageAlt: Ida De Gregorio from Evolve Sprouts

myHistory.title: From the boardroom to the classroom
myHistory.subtitle: After years working in media and hospitality, I felt a growing pull toward something more meaningful, understanding children and supporting families during the years that shape everything.
myHistory.description:
That decision led me back to university. I earned a Master’s in Education from HKU, completed an AMI Montessori Assistant Diploma (0-3) in London, and an AMI Montessori Diploma (3-6) in San Diego, California. I also hold certifications in Child Nutrition from Stanford University and specialised training in Montessori emotional well-being.

For several years, I worked hands-on with children aged 1-6 at Hong Kong’s International Montessori School (IMS), observing closely how children grow when the adults around them understand their developmental needs.

That experience changed how I see childhood, and the role adults play in it.

Today, my work focuses on helping the adults around the child: parents and caregivers. Because what happens in everyday moments at home shapes a child far more than occasional lessons or activities.

I also bring this work into my own life every day with my two daughters, where Montessori is not just a philosophy I teach, it’s how we live.

My goal is simple: to help families create calmer homes, raise capable children, and feel confident in the way they guide their child’s growth.
myHistory.imageAltTemplate: A brief history image from Evolve Sprouts {index}

myJourney.title: Parenting isn't about perfection. It's about progress
myJourney.description: As a mum of two, I've learned that the best parenting happens when we slow down, listen, and give our children space to grow. Montessori principles have transformed how I approach motherhood - and how I help other families do the same.

cards.description: Watching my daughters pour their own water, resolve conflicts with kindness, and embrace mistakes as learning - that didn’t happen without struggle.
I’ve cried after losing my temper. I’ve doubted every choice. Montessori didn’t just shape my children’s growth - it transformed mine.
Replace guilt with grace. See misbehaviour as unmet needs, not defiance. Build a home where both children and parents feel truly seen - not perfect, just growing.

whyUs.title: Your child's most formative years are shaped by the people around them
whyUs.description: In Hong Kong, your child's earliest years are largely shaped by someone who was never trained in child development. That's not a criticism - it's a systemic gap. Evolve Sprouts exists to close it: to give your helper the skills, language, and confidence to raise your child with independence, emotional intelligence, and your family's values.

pillars.title: Built for How Hong Kong Families Actually Live
pillars.description: Your helper learns Montessori principles, calm communication, and age-appropriate strategies - so your child gets consistent, quality guidance in the hours that matter most.

pillars.title: Expert Guidance
pillars.description: Backed by AMI Montessori certification, HKU Master's research, and real parenting experience.

pillars.title: Practical, Not Theoretical
pillars.description: Every session builds skills you'll use in your home - with your exact routines and your specific challenges.

pillars.title: Real Change, Real Fast
pillars.description: Families see tangible shifts within weeks: calmer mornings, happier afternoons, genuine growth.

ida.title: Ida De Gregorio
ida.subtitle: Founder, Evolve Sprouts
ida.description:
Ida is Hong Kong's specialist in Montessori-inspired helper training. She works with families across HK to ensure the person raising your child every day has the skills, language, and confidence to do it well - leading to calmer homes, smoother routines, and more independent children.

Her flagship offer is the 9-Week My Best Auntie Programme, which takes helpers step by step through environment, guidance, and independence - with home visits, weekly challenges, and ongoing support for both helper and parent.
